items.statement: 最终：endo 起始及两种产物的竞争机制
items.expected: The final selected mechanism uses endo OCM followed by connected cycloisomerization and [2+2] branches, and explains their competing accessibility from a balanced free-energy profile. Endo initiation controls the main route; do not confuse local and overall barriers or infer an experimental product yield from this finite model. No CO-insertion [2+1+2] scope expansion.
